name: Factory
description: Spec work becomes merged code: planner and reviewer settle the spec, then implementer and reviewer deliver it, with a human merge column only when the epic asks for it.

steps.instructions: Rework the spec, ADR and any amended contracts to answer the review findings; keep the approved direction intact. One reviewable pull request at the exact head, linked to this ticket, then move the ticket to spec_review. Do not slice until the spec is approved. An external blocker moves the ticket to blocked with the reason.

Review the spec pull request at its exact head against the ticket, the approved direction and the repository standards. Do not rewrite the spec; comment the findings and move the ticket back to spec_progress. On PASS, move it to awaiting_merge if this ticket or its parent carries manual-merge; otherwise move it to done. Never review or merge your own work.

Implement this ticket as one reviewable pull request. Read the ticket, its spec and the repository conventions first; reproduce any demonstrated failure before fixing it. Run the check that covers the diff with a finite timeout. Link the PR to this ticket. Then move the ticket to in_review. Never merge and never review your own work. An external blocker moves the ticket to blocked with the reason. Planner-owned spec text belongs in spec_progress, not here. A human-assigned ticket belongs in human_progress, never here.

Implement this ticket as one reviewable pull request; this column is the human's delivery. Read the ticket, its spec and the repository conventions first. Run the check that covers the diff with a finite timeout. Link the PR to this ticket, then move it to in_review. Never merge and never review your own work. An external blocker moves the ticket to blocked with the reason. Planner-owned spec text belongs in spec_progress, not here.

Review the linked pull request at its exact head against the ticket's acceptance criteria and the repository standards. If this ticket or its parent carries manual-merge, move it to awaiting_merge for the human. Otherwise arm auto-merge (gh pr merge --auto --squash --delete-branch) and move it to done. On a blocking finding, comment the evidence and move it back: human-assigned tickets to human_progress, planner-owned spec text to spec_progress, other delivery to in_progress. Never review or merge your own work.

Merge the reviewed pull request when you are satisfied, then move this ticket to done. If it should change first, move it back to in_progress with the reason, to human_progress for human-assigned work, or to spec_progress for planner-owned spec text.

Triage why the ticket stopped. Planner-owned spec work moves to spec_progress; human-assigned delivery to human_progress; other delivery to in_progress; an external blocker is unblocked or the ticket is cancelled. A blocker is never left parked here.
